selection: Retain every declared grid probe, including unstable cases. Select the lowest absolute peak current with qualifying propagation in both arms. Freeze it across native, time and spatial comparisons.
scope: Extreme unphysical current is an implementation stress fixture only. It is excluded from the supported 0–100 A interface, energy/feasibility claims and qualified operating thresholds. No transfer, waveform, voltage or time is rescaled between a simulation and its reference. The actual modeled axial microcoil may fail to recruit within its declared operating grid.
